DECLARE
 v_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2014. SCR 20608
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.instrument_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT code_desc INTO :ctrl_blk_1.instrument_desc
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'INSTR'
 AND UPPER(CODE) = :ctrl_blk_1.instrument_id
 --AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2014. SCR 20608

 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.INSTRUMENT_ID');
 SHOW_ERROR('0080');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('5403');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;

-- message('test'); 
 synchronize;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 


--- message('test'); 
 synchronize;

 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 
 
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 
 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

PROCEDURE validate_inst_test_id IS

 WHERE machine_test_id = :SYSTEM.CURSOR_VALUE
 --AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+365); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2014. SCR 20608

 BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 365); -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2014. SCR 20608

BEGIN

PROCEDURE validate_pool_size IS
 l_temp NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :VILTS.pool_size IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :VILTS.pool_size = '>1' THEN -- Allow only >1
 NULL;
 ELSE 
 l_temp := TO_NUMBER(:VILTS.POOL_SIZE);
 
 IF l_temp >= 1 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 show_error('5426');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION 
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 show_error('1707');
 check_package_failure; 
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 elsif error_code = 40350 then -- Query caused no records to be retrieved.
 show_error('2331');
 else

 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

declare
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 disp_wh varchar2(3) := null;
 prog_name varchar2(8) := substr(:system.current_form,instr(:system.current_form,'/',-1,1)+1,8);
 PROCEDURE SHOW_HINT Is
 new_item_msg varchar2(80);
 f_block varchar2(30) := GET_FORM_PROPERTY(name_in('system.current_form'),FIRST_NAVIGATION_BLOCK);
 f_item varchar2(80);
 begin
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_block_property(f_block,FIRST_ITEM);
 loop
 exit when get_item_property(f_item,NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' ;
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_item_property(f_item,NEXTITEM);
 end loop;
 default_value('TRUE','global.show_hint');
 If get_item_property(f_item,AUTO_HINT) = 'TRUE' and :global.show_hint = 'TRUE' then
 :global.show_hint := 'FALSE'; 
 new_item_msg := get_item_property(f_item,HINT_TEXT);
 message(substr(new_item_msg,1,80),no_acknowledge);
 end if;
 END;
begin
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.warehouse');
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.label_printer');
 
------------- 
 begin
 select codabar_unit_scheme
 into :global.codabar_unit_scheme
 from institutions;
 --
 select system_users.chapter_id, unit_scheme,
 system_users.testing_lab_code,
 chapters.validate_ff_value,
 decode(sign(nvl(ISBT_start_date,sysdate+1)-sysdate),1,'C','I') 
 into :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :GLOBAL.unit_scheme,
 :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code,
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value, :GLOBAL.current_barcode_default
 from system_users, chapters
 where --upper(user_id) = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid and -- 11g only
 (upper(user_id) = user -- 1og only
 or upper(user_id) = substr(user,5,6) ) and -- 10g only
 system_users.chapter_id = chapters.chapter_id and
 sysdate between system_users.eff_date and
 nvl(system_users.term_date,sysdate+365) and
 sysdate between chapters.eff_date and
 nvl(chapters.term_date,sysdate+365);
 SHOW_HINT; 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting chapter_id for user');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 -- For 10g customers only
 :banner.hdr_date := sysdate; 
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(sysdate,'hh24:mi');
 /* For 11g customers only
 -- Added on 02/16/2011; Timezone conversion code;
 declare
 v_local_time date;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :banner.hdr_date := v_local_time;
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(v_local_time,'hh24:mi');
 else
 :banner.hdr_date := sysdate;
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(sysdate,'hh24:mi');
 end if;
 end;
 */
 ---------- 
----------------------- 
 
 IF :GLOBAL.warehouse is not null THEN
 disp_wh := '[' || :GLOBAL.warehouse || ']'; 
 BEGIN -- modified on 02/16/2011; global.chapter_id condition added to rpt_master_codes;
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x
 FROM rpt_master_codes 
 WHERE APPL_ID = 'DON'
 AND code_type = 'LBLPGM'
 AND code = prog_name;
 --AND nvl(chapter_id, :global.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id; -- 11g only

 IF :GLOBAL.label_printer IS NULL THEN
 BEGIN 
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x
 FROM rpt_master_codes 
 WHERE APPL_ID = 'DON'
 AND code_type = 'LBLPTR'
 AND location_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 --AND nvl(chapter_id, :global.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id; --11g only
 
 Call_Form( lower('ASGLBLPT'));
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := ''; --HCLC Code128



 default_value('UNKNOWN', 'global.program_version');
 :banner.prog_version:='Rel: ' ||:global.program_version || ' ' || disp_wh;
--
 default_value('SYSTEM NAME','global.system_name');
 default_value('MODULE NAME','global.module_name');
--
 :banner.system_name :=
 lpad( :global.system_name, NVL(length(:global.system_name), 0) +
 floor((50 - NVL(length(:global.system_name), 0))/2),' ');
 :banner.module_name :=
 lpad( :global.module_name, NVL(length(:global.module_name), 0) +
 floor((50 - NVL(length(:global.module_name), 0))/2),' ');
--
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('banner.module_name','Bold-underline');
 :banner.prog_name := prog_name;
 
 --11g only
 /*
 if substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,4) = 'OPS$'
 then
 :banner.user_id := substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5,6) ;
 else
 :banner.user_id := substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,6) ;
 end if;
 */
 --10g only
 if substr(user,1,4) = 'OPS$'
 then
 :banner.user_id := substr(user,5,6) ;
 else
 :banner.user_id := substr(user,1,6) ;
 end if;
 --

 default_value ('N/A','global.db_id');
 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,1))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;

 :banner.colon := ':';
